verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes API endpoints to list/get documents (supermemory-docs-60) and self-hosting as a portable binary (supermemory-docs-7, 16, 31, 44), suggesting some data extraction is possible, but there is no documented bulk-export endpoint, standard export format (JSON/CSV), or explicit data-portability/export guarantee anywhere in the docs. missing for 10: a dedicated export/backup API or CLI command, a documented machine-readable export format, and any explicit data-portability statement addressing lock-in concerns.
